review_type: Independent cross-review of the finalized product/capture Markdown and JSON pair
scope: Source precision, exact-article disclosure versus claim coverage and current title, commercial and cost bounds, conditional development rank versus selected information lane, claim-specific prevention/control reasoning, and preservation of six restrictions. This is not an exhaustive legal opinion, claim chart, new valuation or new efficacy result.

review_basis.source_precision_note: The cross-review verifies that the pair states the supported disclosure relationships and preserves the source and access limits. It does not upgrade the author-reported patent connection or unread official records into independently verified title, exact graphical coverage, enforceability or freedom to operate.

checks.finding: The paper-derived full NDC-9009 systematic name is explicitly an inference from published synthesis. Later US11827626B2 section 2.2.51 names C18, permitting a textual connectivity disclosure crosswalk while preserving the distinction from a graphical claim chart or batch authentication. Adjacent same-mass C19 prevents use of m/z306 alone as identification.

The original US20190151303A1 and its successor US10772881B2 are distinguished from the later related grant that names C18. C17-to-E1 sequence in the original application is not silently upgraded to an explicit C18 disclosure. Related issued written claims are acknowledged without pretending that all graphical structures and limitations were mapped.

Public disclosure, issued written claim text, author-reported Neurodon assignment, current ownership, maintained enforceability, license availability and freedom to operate are separate. The official register/assignment and graphical access failures are explicit retrieval limits, not proof of absence. Neither the absence of the word Darier nor a broad SERCA family description determines coverage.

The 2026 methods identify NDC-9009 as a Neurodon gift and CDN1163 separately. This establishes the paper-reported material origin, without implying project receipt, supply permission or identity with NRDN-201/NRDN-301. Sponsor Darier overlap remains program context and does not become clinical efficacy, an exact-code crosswalk or an available license.
The older registry references in US11890279B2 remain earlier-disclosure leads; unreviewed underlying records do not produce priority, novelty, validity or expiration conclusions.

Arcutis and AstraZeneca topical-dermatology rights descriptions are treated as incumbent context and issuer statements. Roflumilast benefit or an additional Darier indication contribution is not treated as a ddiscov-owned asset or a license.

The $40,000–150,000 and 3–6 month envelope is an inherited illustrative assumption, not a quote, verified feasible scope, license-inclusive program budget or spending authority. The original premise includes a functional answer. A readiness-only tranche cannot inherit its rank-4 rationale, even if it fits the same price; it needs a new marginal comparison of actual information value, cost and alternatives including waiting.

Selection of NDC as the next bounded information lane is distinct from the conditional APR-246, RM4404, BLU-3797, NDC-9009 development order. The pair claims no new efficacy, S-tier promotion, quantified EV or automatic funding, and keeps the earlier source lanes closed.

Assembly or marker improvement alone does not establish a useful prevention or ongoing-control product. Established-lesion reversal and off-treatment durability gates apply to their intended claims, so an absent or failed reversal result does not universally falsify prevention or control. Separate claims still require useful benefit, exposure/tolerability, comparator contribution and capture. The wording correction creates no efficacy evidence.

An interpretable negative requires an adequate article, exposure, disease deficit and precision; post-deficit modifiability is required for an intended reversal claim. Model or delivery failure remains inconclusive for target efficacy while potentially stopping commercial spending because a useful question cannot be answered within scope. No protocol or threshold is introduced.

The final Markdown and JSON preserve all six prohibited activity flags as false, accurately distinguish the November 4 America/Los_Angeles evidence cut from November 5 UTC retrieval, and define finite reopening criteria instead of repetitive generic research.

resolved_issues.issue: Potential ambiguity between the evidence date and UTC retrieval date.
resolved_issues.resolution: Final pair explicitly uses as_of 2026-11-04 in America/Los_Angeles and retrieval date 2026-11-05 UTC.

resolved_issues.issue: A narrower article/exposure/model-readiness tranche could otherwise inherit the original functional-answer investment rationale.
resolved_issues.resolution: Final Markdown cost section and JSON tranche_assumption explicitly preserve the original functional-answer premise and require a fresh marginal comparison for a readiness-only scope. It does not inherit rank 4 merely because its cost fits the original range.

open_issues.issue: Exact graphical claim membership, all jurisdictions, current official title and maintenance/enforceability, license availability and freedom to operate remain unverified.
open_issues.why_nonblocking: The bounded source audit clearly disclaims those conclusions and does not authorize commercial execution.
open_issues.reopen_only_for: Substantive exact-product claim analysis, a readable current register or a relevant transaction/rights fact that could change the decision.

open_issues.issue: Actual article/supply access, applicable terms, scoped execution price, timing and readiness are not independently quoted or qualified.
open_issues.why_nonblocking: The illustrative envelope and conditional rank are not promoted into authority or verified feasibility; scope changes explicitly require a new marginal comparison.
open_issues.reopen_only_for: A credible changed cost, scope, execution or rights position that can alter the marginal decision.

open_issues.issue: Claim-specific prevention/control reasoning does not establish clinical prevention, useful ongoing control, reversal, durable benefit or a product advantage.
open_issues.why_nonblocking: The pair retains all evidence gates and expressly treats the amendment as decision logic rather than a positive efficacy result.
open_issues.reopen_only_for: Relevant exact-article functional or controlled clinical evidence, with exposure and comparator context appropriate to the specified claim.
